text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Which should I borrow? I think I've read this one before… Oh!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I've never seen this book before… I thought I'd read everything from Carrot Publications.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wait, could this be… the new release?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wow… I can't believe it's already here.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I shouldn't… but maybe reading just a little won't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just like that, Rice Shower loses herself in the book, forgetting the time and missing training completely.
